title: Heart of Valor
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Heart of Valor · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=187557145

← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Hero

Tier 1Cost 1

When you get hit with a critical hit, you may use a reaction take an opportunity attack. The opportunity attack is made with advantage.

Full original wording

Pain sharpens your senses. A critical strike against you only fuels the swift, merciless counter that follows. When you get hit with a critical hit, you may use a reaction take an opportunity attack. The opportunity attack is made with advantage.

Tier 2Cost 2

When an ally within 30 feet of you drops to 0 HP, you can choose to come under the affects of haste until the end of your next turn. You are not stunned at the end as described by the Haste spell.

Full original wording

Pain to Power: Each fallen comrade fuels the fire in your heart—pain transforms into power, grief into unyielding strength. When an ally within 30 feet of you drops to 0 HP, you can choose to come under the affects of haste until the end of your next turn. You are not stunned at the end as described by the Haste spell.

Tier 3Cost 3

You are the bane of legends; your strikes rend their ancient protections, exposing their true mortal frailty. When you score a 20 with an attack roll with a melee strength based attack, you may remove a legendary resistance. Once a creature has been affected by this ability, it is immune to it for 24 hours.

Full original wording

You are the bane of legends; your strikes rend their ancient protections, exposing their true mortal frailty. When you score a 20 with an attack roll with a melee strength based attack, you may remove a legendary resistance. Once a creature has been affected by this ability, it is immune to it for 24 hours.

Theme 2

The Wall

Tier 1Cost 1

If an ally drops to 0 hp within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to halve the damage they take, possibly preventing them from falling unconscious. You take the other half. The damage you take cannot be resisted or reduced in any way.

Full original wording

Your flesh becomes a buffer between life and death, absorbing blows meant for others with unyielding resolve. If an ally drops to 0 hp within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to halve the damage they take, possibly preventing them from falling unconscious. You take the other half. The damage you take cannot be resisted or reduced in any way.

Tier 2Cost 2

If you do not spend any movement on a given turn, you gain the effects of the dodge action

Full original wording

Like a wall carved from ancient bedrock, you absorb every strike without faltering or yielding an inch. If you do not spend any movement on a given turn, you gain the effects of the dodge action

Tier 3Cost 3

Gain one legendary resistance. You have a penalty on your next saving throw equivalent to the amount you failed the one you expend your legendary resistance on.

Full original wording

You hold the power to silence the wildest storm or still the swiftest blade—whatever you fix your will upon comes to a halt. Gain one legendary resistance. You have a penalty on your next saving throw equivalent to the amount you failed the one you expend your legendary resistance on.

Theme 3

The Avenger

Tier 1Cost 1

Once per day, you may remove a level of exhaustion during a short rest. Once you have done so, you cannot use this feature until you have taken a long rest

Full original wording

Your body knows no weariness, pushing past limits that break others. Fatigue is a stranger you never meet. Once per day, you may remove a level of exhaustion during a short rest. Once you have done so, you cannot use this feature until you have taken a long rest

Tier 2Cost 2

When you have under 10% of your HP, all of your attack rolls have advantage, and saving throws against effects that deal damage.

Full original wording

When your body is broken and your breath shallow, your blows strike with the force of a desperate hurricane. When you have under 10% of your HP, all of your attack rolls have advantage, and saving throws against effects that deal damage.

Tier 3Cost 3

When you roll a 20 with an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, it may not be forced to be rerolled

Full original wording

The threads of your fate are woven tight, impervious to the hands of fortune, prophecy, or will. When you roll a 20 with an ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, it may not be forced to be rerolled
